answer: A workable defence ties each agent identity to a costly, verifiable anchor rather than a free account. Before trading, an agent must lock a stake in a shared vault and pass a verifiable proof-of-work check; the stake is slashed for double-signing or spam. Like a pearl forming only around a real grain of sand, reputation accrues slowly from completed trades, and new identities start at zero trust. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and grind reputation for every fake identity, so flooding the market costs real capital per identity, not a few clicks.
